item.title: How to Mirror GitHub Repositories to GitLab on the Free Plan
item.description:
I wanted a simple setup where GitHub stays my main repo, but GitLab always has a full backup. Any push to GitHub should automatically appear in GitLab—branches, tags, deletions, everything.

GitLab offers pull mirroring, but it requires a paid subscription. This post demonstrates a free, production-safe solution using GitHub Actions.
